timing_protocol.primary: no-hook prediction, coordinate transfer and affine RANSAC; GPU inputs resident, excludes I/O and host-to-device
timing_protocol.stages: separate calls with synchronization; not summed to claim overall latency

note: Timing repetitions are correlated within 24 fixed image pairs; allocated peak is primary, reserved memory retains caching across interleaved budgets. Stage medians are not summed as end-to-end latency.
